scope: Two published profiles only:57mBethanienstraat transition context and17m historical-pair visual class. No other pilot coverage or city expansion accepted.
method: Direct tools.view_image inspection of all nine release source-row/block/opposite-oblique images against prior municipal/challenge review, plus all four release-game screenshots and coarse-pan image. Read final release-game mode/ownership/error/performance report.
nativeFindings: Approved pair retains brown masonry, pale subdivided tall glazing, differentiated street-facing triangular/neck crowns, and no incidental black-rail balconies, shutters, planters or deep cornice.
Adjoining broad pale modern stack/plain groups retain access/flank window hierarchy, slate bases and pale explicit balcony stack. No new material spread, floaters, pane escape or roof gap visible.

Narrow publication removes prior pilot styling from opposite street-side and next frontage beyond pale west neighbor; these visibly revert to baseline red/gray glazing. This is expected outside accepted coverage and does not break historical-pair/modern-flank composition.
gameFindings: Actual-game Photo/Storybook/Cartoon/Procedural images retain installed pair and modern flanks within the running scene. Normal follow camera is overhead; native images supply finer street assembly evidence.
Surrounding ordinary facades preserve windows and doors across modes; no obvious blank-wall regression. Palette changes on omitted pilot buildings reflect reverted unaccepted coverage.
Coarse-pan image retains ordinary facade windows/doors away from stationary rider; current revision and rider detail ownership remain correct.

performance.method: Current final revision EXT fullMap GPU queries,3on/off pairs,90samples per condition after warmup,AppleM4Pro.
performance.interpretation: GPU times remain within local desktop scene budget, but substantial inter-round variability and final pair on<off defeat reliable relative-cost attribution. Raw ratio1.979 is not an isolated historical-class cost or a stable slowdown claim. No city/device generalization.

limits: Stationary rider relocated for scene review; no route reachability claim.
Desktop only; no touch camera/device or citywide GPU acceptance.
Fixed challenge stations now replay corrected failures; not fresh blind transfer.
Exact window columns/crown contours/door-crown assignment remain approximate secondary limits.
Native-height/courtyard/source invariants rely on separate source/geometry tests.
